title: LLMs Model Non-WEIRD Populations: Experiments with Synthetic Cultural Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Creating Synthetic Cultural Agents (SCAs) representing six non-WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) small-scale societies using Search and RAG, and evaluating their decision-making in classic economic games (Dictator Game, Ultimatum Game, Endowment Effect) compared to a baseline WEIRD-centric LLM.
